en: COLLIE grew up on a sheep farm and\nstill visits home every harvest.
COLLIE's first partner was a\nGROWLITHE that helped herd the flock.
COLLIE likes to wear foes down\nwith steady, patient pressure.\pCOLLIE says a good battle is like\na long day of honest work.
People say COLLIE can whistle\nloud enough to be heard a town away.
SPRUCE was raised in a cabin deep\nin the northern pine forest.
SPRUCE carves small wooden POKéMON\nfigures and gives them to children.
SPRUCE favors sturdy POKéMON that\ncan take a hit and stand their ground.
SPRUCE swears that nothing beats\nberries cooked over a campfire.
SPRUCE hopes to plant a tree for\nevery challenger who wins a match.
For all that size, SPRUCE is said to\nbe terrified of thunderstorms.
